book.name: Rom
book.title: Rau To Paulus Imbooda Ila To Yes Roma Rom—Romans

content: Iit tala toman Krisi pa mateeŋ toni, tovenen tapul ŋgar samia ineeple
Yo, ighaze Maaron lolo isamin ghiit ve ireu sosor toit itaghon tau poia toni, pale tasaav vena? Pale tanoknok ghamuuŋ ŋgar samia, leso poia toni tiina iza toit? Ro 3:5+
Maau kat! Iit to taghur ila to Krisi, tapul ŋgar samia wa, tanimale yes mateeŋa. Pale tataghon ataam samia muul vena? Kol 3:3+; 1Pe 2:24
Yam awatag maau? Sawa to tagham ya, itiŋa Yesu Krisi talup ghiit tanim ee moghon, ve tala tomani pa mateeŋ toni. Ga 2:20, 5:24

Onoon kat, sawa to tagham ya, nene inimale tamaat, ve titavia ghiit toman Krisi. Leso laghooŋ toman nepooŋ toit inim paghu, raraate inimale Krisi imaat, ve Tama Maaron tapiri ipamundigini pa mateeŋ. 2Kor 5:17; Ep 2:5+, 4:22+; Kol 2:12
Ighaze tala toman Krisi pa mateeŋ toni ve nepooŋ toit muŋgina isob, nene pale tala tomani pa mundigiiŋ toni paam, ve tagham nepooŋ paghu inimale ye igham nepooŋ paghu. Ro 8:11; Pil 3:10+; 2Tim 2:11
Iit tawatag: Lolood muŋgina, nene tirabi toman Yesu izala ai pambarooŋ wa. Leso ŋgar samia to ipapazaagh ghiit ne tapiri isob, ve tanim mbesooŋa pani muul sob. Ga 2:19-20, 5:24; Kol 3:5
Tamtoghon to ighaze imaat wa, nene samia tapiri irau ikisi muul maau. Ro 8:2; 2Kor 3:17; 1Pe 4:1
Tauto iit taghur ila tovene: Ighaze tala toman Krisi pa mateeŋ toni, nene pale itiŋa Krisi taneep mataad iyaryaar paam. Ro 8:11; 2Tim 2:11
Iit tawatag: Maaron ipamundigin Krisi pa mateeŋ wa, ve irau imaat muul maau. Tauto mateeŋ iŋgini muul maau. Mbaŋ 2:24; Syg 1:18
Pasa, ye imaat pa sosor toit pa ee moghon, ve isob. Irau imaat muul maau. Ve aazne, ye ineep pa igham uraat itaghon Maaron lolo ve ŋgar toni. Hib 7:27, 9:28; 1Pe 3:18

Yam tovene paam. Agham ŋgar aghaze: “Yei to ninim Yesu Krisi le, nipul ŋgar samia wa. Yei ninimale yes mateeŋa to irau tigham ŋgar samia muul maau. Ve aazne, nineep pa ghamuuŋ uraat itaghon Maaron lolo ve ŋgar toni.” 2Kor 5:14+; Ga 2:20; Kol 3:3+
Yam awatag: Muri, yam pale amaat. Tovenen apul samia igham pooz payam malep. Pale ighereb gham ve ataghon ŋgar samia to lolomim igham pani. Mbo 119:133

Aŋgin poian anoŋamim babaŋa tisob, inimale matamim, avomim, nimamim ma venen. Apul di tinim mbesooŋa pa ŋgar samia muul malep. Muuŋ, yam aneep animale yes mateeŋa. Ve aazne, Maaron ipamundigin gham ve agham nepooŋ paghu ila toni wa. Tovenen aghur taumim anim le kat. Ve aghur anoŋamim babaŋa tisob tinim ye le paam, leso tinim mbesooŋa pa ŋgar deŋia. Ro 12:1; 2Kor 5:14+; Kol 3:5
Pasa, yam aneep ila tutuuŋ samba muul maau. Yam aneep ila poia to Maaron samba. Tovenen samia irau igham pooz payam muul maau. Ro 7:4+; Ga 5:18; 1Yo 3:6
Iit tanim mbesooŋa pa ŋgar samia muul maau
Vena? Ighaze iit taneep ila tutuuŋ samba muul maau, ve taneep ila poia to Maaron samba, pale mataad sorok pa ghamuuŋ ŋgar samia? Maau kat! Ro 6:1; 1Pe 2:16; 1Yo 3:9

Yam awatag maau? Ighaze aghur taumim ila tamtoghon eta samba ve ataghon ŋgar toni, yam anim mbesooŋa toni. Ighaze anim mbesooŋa pa ŋgar samia, nene pale ighereb gham pa mateeŋ ve alalemim. Eemoghon ighaze anim mbesooŋa pa Maaron, ve ataghon ŋgar toni, nene pale ighereb gham pa ghamuuŋ ŋgar to deŋia ila ye mata. Yo 8:34; 2Pe 2:19

Muuŋ, yam anim mbesooŋa pa ŋgar samia ve ŋgar tonowen igham pooz payam. Eemoghon iit tapait Maaron! Pasa, sawa to tipatoot gham pa saveeŋ to Krisi, ve tighur gham aneep ila saveeŋ tonowen samba, yam aghur ila, ve aghaze ataghoni kat toman lolomim.
Sawa tonenen, Krisi ipas gham avot pa samia tapiri, ve anim mbesooŋa pa ŋgar deŋia. Yo 8:32; Ro 8:2

You nasavia ataam to Krisi iza to ŋgar to yes mbesooŋa tighamghami, leso iraurau payam pa agham ŋgar pani. Aghita. Muuŋ, yam apul anoŋamim babaŋa naol tinim mbesooŋa pa ŋgar samia. Tauto amalaaŋ pa tutuuŋ to Maaron, ve agham ŋgar naol to tiŋgalaaŋ maau. Ve aazne, yam irau ataghon ŋgar raraate, ve apul anoŋamim babaŋa tisob tinim mbesooŋa pa ŋgar deŋia to Maaron. Leso anim ye le kat, ve ataghon ŋgar patabuaŋ moghon. Ro 12:1
Sawa to yam anim mbesooŋa pa ŋgar samia, ŋgar deŋia igham pooz payam maau.

Vena? Ŋgar to aghami pa sawa tonenen, igham anoŋa poia eta ivot payam? Maau kat. Aazne, matamim iŋgal imuul ila pani, ve mayamim. Pasa, ŋgar tovene pale igham ghiit tamaat ve talaleed. Ro 8:13; Pil 3:19

Eemoghon aazne, Maaron ipas gham avot pa samia tapiri, ve ŋgar tonowen igham pooz payam muul maau. Ve yam anim mbesooŋa to Maaron wa. Tauto aghita anoŋa poia tovene: Yam ataghon ŋgar patabuaŋ ve anim Maaron le kat. Ve muri, yam pale agham nepooŋ poia ila toni itaghoni taghoni gha ila. 1Pe 1:9

Ŋgar samia atia, nene mateeŋ. Eemoghon iit to taneep tuŋia ila to Tiina toit Yesu Krisi, Maaron igham poian ghiit, ve igham leed nepooŋ poia to pale iseeŋga itaghoni taghoni gha ila. Mbnp 2:17; Ezek 18:4; Yo 3:16; Ro 5:12; Yems 1:15
